name: Twin Harbours
idea: Two stone harbours, blue on the left and red on the right, with a short bounce lane between them.
hint: Blue first. The red well sits under the right harbour's roof; the blue well under the left one is reusable.

name: Grey Gate
idea: A stone wall splits the field. Go over the top, or break the grey gate low in the wall and change every trip after it.
hint: The red well is behind the wall. The grey gate is a one-time rebound: keep it, or break it for a short way through.

name: Return Ticket
idea: Blue opens the way to red; a red plug sits on the blue well. Turn red to open your way back to blue.
hint: Blue → red → blue. Break the red plug over the blue well before you need it again. R restarts instantly.
